thread:
sam: after upgrading redwoodctl via brew on my M1, `redwoodctl` isn't on my PATH in iTerm2. I can run /opt/homebrew/bin/redwoodctl directly but not just 'redwoodctl'. also `redwoodctl localserve` complains 'no profiles configured'. anyone seen this?

lee: on mac M1 you need homebrew's shellenv in your login/profile. did you check ~/.zprofile or ~/.zshenv? run `eval \"$(/opt/homebrew/bin/brew shellenv)\"` and then `echo $PATH`.

sam: i added the shellenv line to ~/.zprofile and reopened terminal. now `redwoodctl` is found. localserve starts but login fails: browser opens, i approve, then CLI logs "auth failed, will retry" repeatedly and ends with 'device_code expired'.

tara: try `redwoodctl login --device-code` to copy paste. also check ~/.config/redwood/profiles.json for corrupted JSON or weird timestamps.

sam: profiles.json exists and it's mostly garbage (lots of nulls and a trailing comma). maybe broken migration from older CLI. `redwoodctl logout` didn't remove it.

ops-bot: Note: There's an open ticket DX-4910 about profile migration edge-cases. Temporary fix: move or delete ~/.config/redwood/profiles.json and re-run login.

lee: we should make logout resilient and delete invalid profile files. also installer post-install hook could append brew shellenv to common profile files (zprofile, bash_profile) or at least print a clear message during install.

sam: deleted the file, relogin worked. happily localserve is up. i'll attach the broken file to the ticket.

mike: reassigning DX-4910 to @tara for a small fix: 1) detect parse error and surface an actionable error, 2) ensure logout removes profiles.json on explicit user request, 3) add an installer hint about zprofile for M1.

tara: thanks — i'll open a PR to treat profiles.json parse errors as non-fatal and log the filename + stat info (mode, size, mtime) before falling back. also adding a one-liner in the brew caveats.

sam: filing follow-up: can someone add a DEVEX note for new hires about "if login loops, check profiles.json and shellenv"? saved me an hour. :coffee:

ops-bot: Added note to onboarding checklist (DOCS-1347).
